units.source_text: 我是連狗貓都不如的動物，是癩蛤蟆，只會慢慢爬行。）

en.t: I was an animal lower than even a dog or a cat, a toad that could only crawl slowly along.)

units.source_text: 我的酒癮越來越強，酒量越來越大。

en.t: My craving for alcohol grew stronger and stronger, and the amount I drank kept increasing.

units.source_text: 不光是在高円寺車站附近，也去新宿、銀座一帶喝，有時還會外宿不歸，我已經不再遵循慣例，在酒吧佯裝成無賴漢，見到女人就親。

en.t: I drank not only near Koenji Station but also around Shinjuku and Ginza, sometimes staying out all night; I no longer followed the usual rules, pretending to be a roughneck in bars and kissing any woman I saw.

units.source_text: 總之，我又變得像殉情以前，不，變成了比那時更放縱更鄙俗的酒鬼，沒錢花，就把靜子的衣服拿去當掉。

en.t: In short, I became like I had been before the double suicide attempt; no, I became an even more dissolute and vulgar drunk than I had been then, and when I ran out of money I pawned Shizuko's clothes.

units.source_text: 自從來到靜子的公寓，望著那破爛不堪的風箏苦笑後，一年多的時光一晃而過。

en.t: More than a year had slipped by since I came to Shizuko's apartment and smiled bitterly at that tattered kite.
